hero.kicker: We are 4810, we are a family
hero.title: A strength called family
hero.sub: We are the Grivels of Courmayeur. Our story has been tied to the mountains for over two centuries.

story.title: The Dolonne forge
story.text: Our forefather, Henry Grivel, designed the first pair of 10-point crampons and changed climbing forever. After founding the Grivel workshop in Dolonne, he was joined by his children Laurent, Camille and Aimée.

story.title: 4810 is born
story.text: We named the shop 4810 in honour of Mont Blanc. Walter, Camille's son, was the first to open its doors. Today the tradition continues with his sons Enrico and André.

story.title: The future
story.text: Passing on the Grivel family's tradition and passion to the next generation: Laurent, Thomas and Joseph.

family.quote: The shop for mountain lovers, the restaurant for food lovers, the chalet for nature lovers.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.sub: Quick answers about ski rental, the shop and the restaurant.

items.q: Are you close to the lifts?
items.a: Yes. 4810 Rental in Dolonne is 100 metres from the gondola station.
Yes, ski suits for adults only, at our Dolonne shop. We don't rent goggles, sunglasses or gloves.
Yes, you can choose between Burton and Nitro boards.

Yes, everything you need to climb safely on rock, ice or mixed terrain.
Yes, heated, self-sanitising lockers for skis and boots, for a day, six months or a year. There's no need for storage on the slopes: we're right next to the lifts.

items.q: Can I rent skis for the whole season?
items.a: Yes, for both adults and children. We also offer an annual subscription.
Yes, skis from our rental fleet: try them and, if you love them, buy them.

items.q: What are the Via Roma shop's opening hours?
items.a: Every day {shopHours}, all year round. In Dolonne: every day {dolonneHours}.

items.q: Do you rent pushchairs and baby carriers?
items.a: Yes, all-terrain pushchairs and baby carriers.
Yes, it's one of our specialities: on Via Roma you'll find everything for rock and ice.

items.q: Where can I go with an e-bike?
items.a: There are plenty of routes: our team will point out the most beautiful trails and give you maps.

items.q: Do you organise snowshoe walks or hikes?
items.a: No, but we're happy to put you in touch with the Courmayeur mountain guides.

items.q: Do you sell golf or tennis gear?
